models_evaluated: paper-format denosumab-induced hypocalcemia risk prediction model

links.outcome: Pharmacist perceptions of usability and integration barriers of a paper-format prediction tool
links.effect: Some participants gave neutral feedback on ease of use (10/49, 20.4%); manual data input and paper format were identified as limitations, with EHR integration needed.
links.quote: One concern was the inconvenience of implementing a paper-format tool in clinical environments that primarily operate on electronic health records.

screen.reason: Empirical usability study evaluating the utility and implementation barriers of a risk prediction model tested outside routine workflow by hospital pharmacists via a paper format.
